answer: One defense is stake-weighted attestation: to join the horizon of trusted graders, an agent must lock a refundable bond and earn endorsements from established peers over time. A hollow identity with no history and no stake cannot vote, grade, or claim rewards, so creating a thousand fake accounts costs a thousand bonds and a thousand endorsement histories. An umber-flagged account that behaves badly loses its bond and its endorsements, making each Sybil attempt expensive while honest newcomers can still earn their way in cheaply by doing real work.
